doc-index-callout.notes: Index discovery callout present at top of every fetched page.

best-practices-for-claude-code.notes: Page title and lead blurb describing Claude Code as an agentic coding environment.

agentic-loop-intro.notes: Describes the shift from review-based to describe-and-delegate workflow. Frames constraints to understand.

context-window-constraint.notes: Core constraint: context fills fast, performance degrades as it fills. Links to cost reduction strategies.

give-claude-a-way-to-verify-its-work.notes: Primary recommendation: provide tests, screenshots, or expected outputs. Highest-leverage practice.

verification-strategies-table.notes: Before/after table: verification criteria, visual UI checks, root-cause vs symptom framing.

verification-tools-detail.notes: Chrome extension for UI verification; test suites, linters, Bash commands as verification mechanisms.

explore-first-then-plan-then-code.notes: Four-phase workflow: Explore (Plan Mode), Plan, Implement (Normal Mode), Commit.

plan-mode-overhead-callout.notes: Plan Mode adds overhead; skip for small, clear-scope tasks. Use when uncertain or multi-file.

provide-specific-context-in-your-prompts.notes: Precision reduces corrections. Scope, source references, pattern references, symptom descriptions.

context-strategies-table.notes: Before/after table for prompt specificity: scope, sources, patterns, symptoms.

vague-prompts-caveat.notes: Vague prompts are valid for exploratory work where course-correction is cheap.

provide-rich-content.notes: @ file references, image paste, URL input, pipe data, let Claude fetch. /permissions to allowlist domains.

configure-your-environment.notes: Section intro: environment setup makes Claude Code more effective across sessions.

write-an-effective-claudemd.notes: CLAUDE.md loaded every session. /init generates starter. Keep concise or instructions get ignored.

claudemd-include-exclude-table.notes: What to include vs exclude in CLAUDE.md. Include: Bash commands, style rules, testing, repo etiquette.

claudemd-maintenance-tips.notes: Treat CLAUDE.md like code; prune regularly; IMPORTANT/YOU MUST for adherence; check into git.

claudemd-import-syntax.notes: @path/to/import syntax for importing other files into CLAUDE.md.

claudemd-locations.notes: Location hierarchy: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (global), ./CLAUDE.md (project), ./CLAUDE.local.md (personal), parent dirs, child dirs.

configure-permissions.notes: Three modes: auto mode (classifier), permission allowlists, sandboxing. Each trades off safety vs. interruption frequency.

use-cli-tools.notes: CLI tools (gh, aws, gcloud) are most context-efficient for external services. Claude can learn unknown CLIs.

connect-mcp-servers.notes: MCP servers extend Claude to external services: issue trackers, databases, Figma, workflows.

set-up-hooks.notes: Hooks are deterministic guarantees vs CLAUDE.md advisory instructions. Use for zero-exception actions.

create-skills.notes: Skills in .claude/skills/ with SKILL.md. Auto-applied or invoked with /skill-name. disable-model-invocation for side-effect workflows.

create-custom-subagents.notes: Subagents in .claude/agents/ with frontmatter: name, description, tools, model. Run in own context with own allowed tools.

install-plugins.notes: Plugins bundle skills, hooks, subagents, MCP. /plugin to browse. Decision guidance: features-overview#match-features-to-your-goal.

communicate-effectively.notes: Section intro: communication style impacts output quality.

ask-codebase-questions.notes: Claude Code as onboarding tool; ask same questions as a senior engineer. Reduces ramp-up time.

let-claude-interview-you.notes: AskUserQuestion tool for requirements gathering before implementation. Fresh session after spec is complete.

manage-your-session.notes: Section intro: conversations are persistent and reversible.

course-correct-early-and-often.notes: Tight feedback loops produce better results. Esc, /rewind, /clear are key session controls.

manage-context-aggressively.notes: Auto compaction, /clear, /compact, /rewind+Summarize, /btw for side questions. Customize compaction in CLAUDE.md.

use-subagents-for-investigation.notes: Subagents run in separate context windows, report summaries. Keeps main context clean. Use for research and verification.

rewind-with-checkpoints.notes: Checkpoints track only Claude-made changes, not external processes. Not a git replacement.

resume-conversations.notes: claude --continue / --resume for multi-session tasks. /rename for descriptive names. Sessions as branches.

automate-and-scale.notes: Section intro: scale beyond one session with parallel, non-interactive, and fan-out patterns.

run-non-interactive-mode.notes: claude -p for CI, hooks, scripts. --output-format text/json/stream-json for programmatic parsing.

run-multiple-claude-sessions.notes: Parallel sessions via desktop app, web (isolated VMs), or agent teams. Writer/Reviewer pattern example.

fan-out-across-files.notes: Loop claude -p per file for large migrations. --allowedTools to scope permissions for unattended batch runs.

run-autonomously-with-auto-mode.notes: Auto mode: classifier blocks risky actions; aborts non-interactive run if repeatedly blocked.

avoid-common-failure-patterns.notes: Five anti-patterns: kitchen-sink session, repeated corrections, over-specified CLAUDE.md, trust-verify gap, infinite exploration.

develop-your-intuition.notes: Patterns are starting points; context accumulation, planning, and specificity all have valid exceptions.

related-resources.notes: Links to How Claude Code works, Extend Claude Code, Common workflows, CLAUDE.md memory docs.
